results.name: Production app starts via secure custom protocol with sandboxed bridge
Every native file operation rejects ungranted renderer paths
Preload refuses a fabricated File path and does not expose ipcRenderer
Real native open returns valid selections alongside per-file errors
Production CSP blocks inline script execution
Actual renderer edit updates Undo and can be reversed
Real export uses the main-process save path and PNG bytes
Color-only photo edits render through the real worker
Mode handover uses the actually loaded logo source, not stale history
Real folder batch creates a unique child and reports success
Rendered numeric controls and thumbnails have accessible names
Dirty window close asks and keeps the window on cancellation
